zh: 他唱了一首很好听的歌。
py: tā chàng le yī shǒu hěn hǎo tīng de gē
en: He sang a very nice song.
why: Songs take 首. The measure sits between 一 and the modifier plus noun.

s: 他家的那条狗每天陪他去公园跑步。
s_py: tā jiā de nà tiáo gǒu měi tiān péi tā qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
zh: 他家的那条狗每天陪他去公园跑步。
py: tā jiā de nà tiáo gǒu měi tiān péi tā qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
en: His dog goes running in the park with him every day.
why: Dogs can take 条 as well as 只, so 条 is acceptable here.

s: 我给教练写了一个信，请他让我进球队。
s_py: wǒ gěi jiào liàn xiě le yí gè xìn qǐng tā ràng wǒ jìn qiú duì
zh: 我给教练写了一封信，请他让我进球队。
py: wǒ gěi jiào liàn xiě le yī fēng xìn qǐng tā ràng wǒ jìn qiú duì
en: I wrote the coach a letter asking him to let me join the team.
why: Letters take 封. 个 is not a universal substitute.

q: 我家有四___人，爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
zh: 我家有四口人，爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
py: wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén bà bà mā mā gē gē hé wǒ
en: There are four people in my family: Dad, Mum, my older brother and me.
why: Members of a family are counted with 口. 家 is for businesses, 间 for rooms, 座 for big buildings.

q: 那___孩子每天下午都在公园打羽毛球。
zh: 那个孩子每天下午都在公园打羽毛球。
py: nà ge hái zi měi tiān xià wǔ dōu zài gōng yuán dǎ yǔ máo qiú
en: That child plays badminton in the park every afternoon.
why: One child: 那 + 个 + noun. 那些 would mean 'those children', and the English cue is singular.

q: 妈妈给我准备了一___早饭，有鸡蛋和牛奶，让我吃完再去踢球。
zh: 妈妈给我准备了一份早饭，有鸡蛋和牛奶，让我吃完再去踢球。
py: mā mā gěi wǒ zhǔn bèi le yī fèn zǎo fàn yǒu jī dàn hé niú nǎi ràng wǒ chī wán zài qù tī qiú
en: Mum prepared a breakfast for me, with eggs and milk, and told me to finish it before going to play football.
why: A prepared portion of food is a 份. 双 is for pairs, 套 for sets and 瓶 for bottles.

q: 他上个月到体育学院去了两___，每次都是坐地铁去、坐地铁回。
zh: 他上个月到体育学院去了两趟，每次都是坐地铁去、坐地铁回。
py: tā shàng gè yuè dào tǐ yù xué yuàn qù le liǎng tàng měi cì dōu shì zuò dì tiě qù zuò dì tiě huí
en: Last month he went to the sports institute twice, each time going and coming back by subway.
why: Trips there and back are counted with 趟. 遍 is for passes through a text, and 个 and 首 do not count journeys.

q: 请给我来一杯___咖啡。
zh: 请给我来一杯咖啡。
py: qǐng gěi wǒ lái yī bēi kā fēi
en: Please give me a cup of coffee.
why: 杯 is already the measure, so nothing goes between 杯 and 咖啡. 一杯的咖啡 and 一杯个咖啡 are both wrong.

zh: 桌子上有一杯咖啡。
py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī bēi kā fēi
en: There is a cup of coffee on the table.
why: 杯 is already the measure, so 一杯咖啡 needs nothing more. The existential 有 follows the place.

q: 这位运动员练了十___年才得到第一块金牌。
zh: 这位运动员练了十年才得到第一块金牌。
py: zhè wèi yùn dòng yuán liàn le shí nián cái dé dào dì yī kuài jīn pái
en: This athlete trained for ten years before winning his first gold medal.
why: 年 is itself a measure, so 十年 and never 十个年. 个 would be wrong even with a large number.

q: 我住在八___，坐电梯很方便。
zh: 我住在八层，坐电梯很方便。
py: wǒ zhù zài bā céng zuò diàn tī hěn fāng biàn
en: I live on the eighth floor, and it is easy to take the lift.
why: A floor of a building is 层. 座 would count whole buildings, 间 rooms and 家 businesses.

s: 我们昨天看了一首电影。
s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān kàn le yī shǒu diàn yǐng
zh: 我们昨天看了一部电影。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān kàn le yī bù diàn yǐng
en: We watched a film yesterday.
why: Films take 部. 首 is only for songs and poems.

q: 公园里有两___大树，下面有很多人在打太极拳。
zh: 公园里有两棵大树，下面有很多人在打太极拳。
py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu liǎng kē dà shù xià miàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài dǎ tài jí quán
en: There are two big trees in the park, and many people are doing tai chi under them.
why: Trees take 棵. 朵 is for flowers, and 片 would mean a patch or slice, not a whole tree.

q: 足球比赛前，我们在球场边买了十___水，分给队员们喝。
zh: 足球比赛前，我们在球场边买了十瓶水，分给队员们喝。
py: zú qiú bǐ sài qián wǒ men zài qiú chǎng biān mǎi le shí píng shuǐ fēn gěi duì yuán men hē
en: Before the football match we bought ten bottles of water by the pitch and shared them out among the players.
why: Water bought in bottles is counted with 瓶: 十瓶水. 个 would count items, 双 is for pairs and 份 for portions.

s: 球场上有一位人在跑步。
s_py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu yī wèi rén zài pǎo bù
zh: 球场上有一个人在跑步。
py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu yí gè rén zài pǎo bù
en: There is someone running on the pitch.
why: 位 is polite and goes before a role word, not before bare 人.

s: 我弟弟有一双很大的足球鞋。
s_py: wǒ dì di yǒu yī shuāng hěn dà de zú qiú xié
zh: 我弟弟有一双很大的足球鞋。
py: wǒ dì di yǒu yī shuāng hěn dà de zú qiú xié
en: My younger brother has a pair of very big football boots.
why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双 is right even with a long modifier.

zh: 我昨天去了一趟医院。
py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī tàng yī yuàn
en: I made a trip to the hospital yesterday.
why: A trip takes 趟 and it goes after the verb 了 and before the place: 去了一趟医院.

s: 跑完步我想喝一个杯水。
s_py: pǎo wán bù wǒ xiǎng hē yí gè bēi shuǐ
zh: 跑完步我想喝一杯水。
py: pǎo wán bù wǒ xiǎng hē yī bēi shuǐ
en: After running I want a glass of water.
why: 杯 is already the measure for a drink, so 个 must not go before it.

q: 这场比赛要打两___小时，你先吃点东西吧。
zh: 这场比赛要打两个小时，你先吃点东西吧。
py: zhè chǎng bǐ sài yào dǎ liǎng gè xiǎo shí nǐ xiān chī diǎn dōng xī ba
en: This match takes two hours to play, so eat something first.
why: Hours are counted with 个 in a sentence like this: 两个小时. 场 and 次 count events and occasions, not time lengths.

s: 这个学期我有三门课，每周共有十二节课。
s_py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ yǒu sān mén kè měi zhōu gòng yǒu shí èr jié kè
zh: 这个学期我有三门课，每周共有十二节课。
py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ yǒu sān mén kè měi zhōu gòng yǒu shí èr jié kè
en: This term I have three courses and twelve class periods a week.
why: 门 counts subjects and 节 counts timetable periods, so both are right.

zh: 桌子上有一些水果。
py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī xiē shuǐ guǒ
en: There is some fruit on the table.
why: 一些 goes straight onto the noun with no other measure in between.

zh: 他每天睡八个小时。
py: tā měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí
en: He sleeps eight hours every day.
why: 小时 needs 个: 八个小时. 每天 has no 个 because 天 is itself a measure.

q: 我想买两___看球赛的票。
zh: 我想买两张看球赛的票。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng zhāng kàn qiú sài de piào
en: I want to buy two tickets for the match.
why: Tickets are flat, so 张. 本 is for bound volumes and 件 for clothes and matters.

zh: 我们学校有两座体育馆。
py: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu liǎng zuò tǐ yù guǎn
en: Our school has two gyms.
why: Big fixed buildings take 座 and the number comes before the measure.

q: ___篮球都是新的，今天第一次用。
zh: 这三个篮球都是新的，今天第一次用。
py: zhè sān gè lán qiú dōu shì xīn de jīn tiān dì yī cì yòng
en: These three basketballs are all new; we are using them for the first time today.
why: Pointing word, then number, then measure: 这三个篮球. 三这个 and 这个三 put the pieces in the wrong order.

zh: 这三本书都是我的。
py: zhè sān běn shū dōu shì wǒ de
en: These three books are all mine.
why: Pointing word, number, measure, noun: 这三本书. The measure cannot come before the number.

q: 那些___球拍都是教练送给我们的。
zh: 那些球拍都是教练送给我们的。
py: nà xiē qiú pāi dōu shì jiào liàn sòng gěi wǒ men de
en: Those rackets were all given to us by the coach.
why: 些 already fills the measure slot. 那些把球拍 and 那些支球拍 add a second measure, which is wrong.

q: 这条街上有___商店，有的卖运动鞋，有的卖自行车。
zh: 这条街上有一些商店，有的卖运动鞋，有的卖自行车。
py: zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu yī xiē shāng diàn yǒu de mài yùn dòng xié yǒu de mài zì xíng chē
en: On this street there are some shops; some sell trainers and some sell bicycles.
why: 一些 is for countable things. 三些 is impossible because 些 only goes with 一, and 一点儿 is for uncountable amounts.

q: 钓鱼的时候他运气很好，一个上午就钓到了五___大鱼。
zh: 钓鱼的时候他运气很好，一个上午就钓到了五条大鱼。
py: diào yú de shí hòu tā yùn qì hěn hǎo yí gè shàng wǔ jiù diào dào le wǔ tiáo dà yú
en: He was lucky while fishing and caught five big fish in a single morning.
why: Fish take 条. 只 and 头 are for land animals, and 匹 is for horses.

q: 我学了三___年游泳。
zh: 我学了三年游泳。
py: wǒ xué le sān nián yóu yǒng
en: I have studied swimming for three years.
why: 年 is itself a measure, so the number goes straight on: 三年. 三个年 is wrong.

s: 这位是我们的新教练，他以前在北京踢过球。
s_py: zhè wèi shì wǒ men de xīn jiào liàn tā yǐ qián zài běi jīng tī guò qiú
zh: 这位是我们的新教练，他以前在北京踢过球。
py: zhè wèi shì wǒ men de xīn jiào liàn tā yǐ qián zài běi jīng tī guò qiú
en: This is our new coach; he used to play football in Beijing.
why: 位 is correct before a role word and is polite when introducing someone.

q: 这___书都是我借来的，不是买的。
zh: 这些书都是我借来的，不是买的。
py: zhè xiē shū dōu shì wǒ jiè lái de bú shì mǎi de
en: These books are all ones I borrowed, not bought.
why: 都 shows several books: 这些书. 这本书 is one book, and 这个书 is not the standard way to say it.

q: 李教练，您好，这___是我们队的新队员小王。
zh: 李教练，您好，这位是我们队的新队员小王。
py: lǐ jiào liàn nín hǎo zhè wèi shì wǒ men duì de xīn duì yuán xiǎo wáng
en: Hello, Coach Li, this is Xiao Wang, a new player in our team.
why: Introducing someone to a senior person calls for the polite 位 before the role. 口, 家 and 座 do not count people this way.

q: 周末我要去一___书店，顺便给你买本词典。
zh: 周末我要去一趟书店，顺便给你买本词典。
py: zhōu mò wǒ yào qù yī tàng shū diàn shùn biàn gěi nǐ mǎi běn cí diǎn
en: This weekend I'm going to the bookshop, and I will buy you a dictionary on the way.
why: A trip to a place takes 趟. 遍 needs something to be gone through from start to finish, and 个 does not count trips.

q: 我买了一些___水果，周末带去公园。
zh: 我买了一些水果，周末带去公园。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ zhōu mò dài qù gōng yuán
en: I bought some fruit to take to the park at the weekend.
why: 一些 already fills the measure slot, so no other measure follows. 一些个水果 and 一些件水果 are wrong.

s: 河上有一间很长的桥，骑车要十分钟。
s_py: hé shàng yǒu yī jiān hěn cháng de qiáo qí chē yào shí fēn zhōng
zh: 河上有一座很长的桥，骑车要十分钟。
py: hé shàng yǒu yī zuò hěn cháng de qiáo qí chē yào shí fēn zhōng
en: There is a very long bridge over the river; it takes ten minutes to cycle across.
why: Bridges take 座. 间 is only for rooms.

q: 体育馆外面停着一___白色的车。
zh: 体育馆外面停着一辆白色的车。
py: tǐ yù guǎn wài miàn tíng zhe yī liàng bái sè de chē
en: A white car is parked outside the gym.
why: Anything on wheels takes 辆. 台 is for machines, 部 for phones, 匹 for horses.

s: 他在城里买了一件黑色的裤子。
s_py: tā zài chéng lǐ mǎi le yī jiàn hēi sè de kù zi
zh: 他在城里买了一条黑色的裤子。
py: tā zài chéng lǐ mǎi le yī tiáo hēi sè de kù zi
en: He bought a pair of black trousers in town.
why: Trousers take 条. 件 is for tops and matters.

q: 比赛结束后，教练给每个队员发了一___蛋糕。
zh: 比赛结束后，教练给每个队员发了一块蛋糕。
py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu jiào liàn gěi měi gè duì yuán fā le yī kuài dàn gāo
en: After the match the coach gave each player a piece of cake.
why: A piece cut from a cake is 块. 条, 朵 and 棵 are for long things, flowers and trees.

q: 他在花店买了一___红玫瑰，送给女朋友。
zh: 他在花店买了一朵红玫瑰，送给女朋友。
py: tā zài huā diàn mǎi le yī duǒ hóng méi guī sòng gěi nǚ péng yǒu
en: He bought one red rose at the florist's and gave it to his girlfriend.
why: A single flower counts with 朵. 棵 is for trees and plants, and 封 is for letters.

s: 公园门口停着一只自行车。
s_py: gōng yuán mén kǒu tíng zhe yī zhī zì xíng chē
zh: 公园门口停着一辆自行车。
py: gōng yuán mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng zì xíng chē
en: A bicycle is parked at the park entrance.
why: Anything with wheels takes 辆. 只 is for small animals.

q: 我最喜欢听这___歌，每次跑步都听。
zh: 我最喜欢听这首歌，每次跑步都听。
py: wǒ zuì xǐ huān tīng zhè shǒu gē měi cì pǎo bù dōu tīng
en: I like listening to this song best; I play it every time I run.
why: Songs take 首. 部 is for films and novels, 门 for subjects, 节 for class periods.

q: 裁判把比赛规则从头到尾说了一___，大家才听明白。
zh: 裁判把比赛规则从头到尾说了一遍，大家才听明白。
py: cái pàn bǎ bǐ sài guī zé cóng tóu dào wěi shuō le yī biàn dà jiā cái tīng míng bái
en: The referee went through the rules from start to finish before everyone understood.
why: Going through all the rules from beginning to end is 遍. 趟 is for journeys and 个 does not count passes.

s: 我买了三些苹果。
s_py: wǒ mǎi le sān xiē píng guǒ
zh: 我买了一些苹果。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē píng guǒ
en: I bought some apples.
why: 些 only combines with 一; with other numbers use a real measure such as 个.

zh: 门口停着一辆红色的车。
py: mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng hóng sè de chē
en: A red car is parked at the door.
why: A car has wheels: 辆. The place comes first and the thing that is there comes last.

q: 这___山不太高，我们一个上午就爬上去了。
zh: 这座山不太高，我们一个上午就爬上去了。
py: zhè zuò shān bù tài gāo wǒ men yí gè shàng wǔ jiù pá shàng qù le
en: This mountain is not very high; we climbed it in one morning.
why: Mountains take 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses and 层 for floors.

q: 他用一___钢笔把比赛成绩记在了本子上。
zh: 他用一支钢笔把比赛成绩记在了本子上。
py: tā yòng yī zhī gāng bǐ bǎ bǐ sài chéng jì jì zài le běn zi shàng
en: He wrote the match results in his notebook with a fountain pen.
why: Pens take 支. 把 is for handled things, and 张 for flat sheets.

q: 那___体育馆很大，可以同时坐五万人看比赛。
zh: 那座体育馆很大，可以同时坐五万人看比赛。
py: nà zuò tǐ yù guǎn hěn dà kě yǐ tóng shí zuò wǔ wàn rén kàn bǐ sài
en: That stadium is huge and can seat fifty thousand people to watch a match at the same time.
why: Huge fixed buildings take 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses, 层 for floors.

q: 这个学期我选了三___选修课，有游泳、摄影和书法。
zh: 这个学期我选了三门选修课，有游泳、摄影和书法。
py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ xuǎn le sān mén xuǎn xiū kè yǒu yóu yǒng shè yǐng hé shū fǎ
en: This term I chose three elective courses: swimming, photography and calligraphy.
why: Three different subjects are 三门课. 节 would count class periods, and 首 and 顿 are for songs and meals.

q: 他每个星期游三___泳。
zh: 他每个星期游三次泳。
py: tā měi gè xīng qī yóu sān cì yǒng
en: He swims three times a week.
why: How often an action happens is counted with 次 after the verb. 个 does not count occasions and 遍 means a full pass.

q: 昨天晚上我们看了一___很精彩的足球比赛。
zh: 昨天晚上我们看了一场很精彩的足球比赛。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ men kàn le yī chǎng hěn jīng cǎi de zú qiú bǐ sài
en: Last night we watched a really exciting football match.
why: A match is an event that runs its course: 场. 首 is for songs, 节 for class periods and 顿 for meals.

q: 我们在球场旁边的小店吃了两___面条。
zh: 我们在球场旁边的小店吃了两碗面条。
py: wǒ men zài qiú chǎng páng biān de xiǎo diàn chī le liǎng wǎn miàn tiáo
en: We ate two bowls of noodles at the little shop next to the sports ground.
why: The bowl is the measure for noodles: 两碗面条. 双 is for pairs, 件 for clothes, 套 for sets.

q: 新开的健身房里有二十___跑步机。
zh: 新开的健身房里有二十台跑步机。
py: xīn kāi de jiàn shēn fáng lǐ yǒu èr shí tái pǎo bù jī
en: The new gym has twenty treadmills.
why: A treadmill is a machine, so 台. 辆 is for wheeled vehicles and 只 for small animals.

q: 我们班每___学生都喜欢运动。
zh: 我们班每个学生都喜欢运动。
py: wǒ men bān měi gè xué shēng dōu xǐ huān yùn dòng
en: Every student in our class likes sports.
why: 每 needs a measure before the noun: 每个学生. 每学生 drops it, and 每的学生 is not Chinese.

s: 球员们每人喝了一瓶的水，然后继续练习。
s_py: qiú yuán men měi rén hē le yī píng de shuǐ rán hòu jì xù liàn xí
zh: 球员们每人喝了一瓶水，然后继续练习。
py: qiú yuán men měi rén hē le yī píng shuǐ rán hòu jì xù liàn xí
en: Each player drank a bottle of water and then went on practising.
why: 瓶 is the measure and no 的 goes between 一瓶 and 水.

q: 我去过两___上海，都是去看球赛。
zh: 我去过两次上海，都是去看球赛。
py: wǒ qù guò liǎng cì shàng hǎi dōu shì qù kàn qiú sài
en: I have been to Shanghai twice, both times to watch a match.
why: Counting visits uses 次. 遍 is for going through something from start to finish, and 个 does not count times.

s: 每个队员都有一件红色的球衣。
s_py: měi gè duì yuán dōu yǒu yī jiàn hóng sè de qiú yī
zh: 每个队员都有一件红色的球衣。
py: měi gè duì yuán dōu yǒu yī jiàn hóng sè de qiú yī
en: Every player has a red jersey.
why: 每个 plus noun is the right shape, and 件 is the measure for a top.

q: 这本小说很好看，我已经从头到尾读了三___。
zh: 这本小说很好看，我已经从头到尾读了三遍。
py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō hěn hǎo kàn wǒ yǐ jīng cóng tóu dào wěi dú le sān biàn
en: This novel is great; I have read it from beginning to end three times.
why: Reading from start to finish is 遍. 趟 counts trips and 个 counts objects, not passes through a book.

q: 他每个星期六下午都有一___钢琴课，一上就是两个小时。
zh: 他每个星期六下午都有一节钢琴课，一上就是两个小时。
py: tā měi gè xīng qī liù xià wǔ dōu yǒu yī jié gāng qín kè yī shàng jiù shì liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: Every Saturday afternoon he has a piano lesson, which lasts two hours.
why: A single lesson slot takes 节. 门 would be a whole subject or course, and 首 and 顿 do not fit 课.

q: 你们几___人一起去打球？
zh: 你们几个人一起去打球？
py: nǐ men jǐ gè rén yì qǐ qù dǎ qiú
en: How many of you are going to play ball together?
why: 几 needs a measure before the noun: 几个人. 几人 drops it, and 口 only counts family members, which does not fit a game.

q: 他骑着一___马在草地上跑了一圈。
zh: 他骑着一匹马在草地上跑了一圈。
py: tā qí zhe yì pǐ mǎ zài cǎo dì shàng pǎo le yī quān
en: He rode a horse once round the grass.
why: Horses take 匹. 条 is for fish, 只 for small animals and 头 for cattle and pigs.

s: 他在这个队踢了三个年球。
s_py: tā zài zhè ge duì tī le sān gè nián qiú
zh: 他在这个队踢了三年球。
py: tā zài zhè ge duì tī le sān nián qiú
en: He has played football in this team for three years.
why: 年 is itself a measure, so 三年, never 三个年.

q: 公园里有一___小鸟在树上唱歌。
zh: 公园里有一只小鸟在树上唱歌。
py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yī zhī xiǎo niǎo zài shù shàng chàng gē
en: There is a little bird singing in a tree in the park.
why: Small animals and birds take 只. 条 is for fish, 头 for cattle and pigs, 匹 for horses.

s: 我们班有三学生喜欢游泳。
s_py: wǒ men bān yǒu sān xué shēng xǐ huān yóu yǒng
zh: 我们班有三个学生喜欢游泳。
py: wǒ men bān yǒu sān gè xué shēng xǐ huān yóu yǒng
en: Three students in our class like swimming.
why: A number cannot sit directly on a noun; 学生 needs the measure 个 in between.

q: 比赛前，有两___老教练在场边给我们讲了话。
zh: 比赛前，有两位老教练在场边给我们讲了话。
py: bǐ sài qián yǒu liǎng wèi lǎo jiào liàn zài chǎng biān gěi wǒ men jiǎng le huà
en: Before the match two senior coaches spoke to us at the side of the pitch.
why: Respected people are counted with 位 before their role word. 口 is for family members, 家 for businesses, 座 for big structures.

q: 他每___天都去公园跑步。
zh: 他每天都去公园跑步。
py: tā měi tiān dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
en: He goes running in the park every day.
why: 天 is itself a measure, so no 个: 每天. 每个天 is wrong.

q: 他拍了一___讲足球的电影，很受欢迎。
zh: 他拍了一部讲足球的电影，很受欢迎。
py: tā pāi le yī bù jiǎng zú qiú de diàn yǐng hěn shòu huān yíng
en: He made a film about football and it was very popular.
why: A film as a work takes 部. 场 would be one showing, which does not fit 拍 'make'.

q: 俱乐部在城里给球员租了一___房子，有三间卧室和两个卫生间。
zh: 俱乐部在城里给球员租了一套房子，有三间卧室和两个卫生间。
py: jù lè bù zài chéng lǐ gěi qiú yuán zū le yī tào fáng zi yǒu sān jiān wò shì hé liǎng gè wèi shēng jiān
en: The club rented a flat in the city for the players, with three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
why: A flat or house as a self-contained unit takes 套. 份 is for portions and jobs, 双 for pairs, 瓶 for bottles.

s: 我每个月去一次北京，每次住三天。
s_py: wǒ měi gè yuè qù yī cì běi jīng měi cì zhù sān tiān
zh: 我每个月去一次北京，每次住三天。
py: wǒ měi gè yuè qù yī cì běi jīng měi cì zhù sān tiān
en: I go to Beijing once a month and stay three days each time.
why: 月 takes 个 but 天 never does, and 次 counts the visits.

q: 周三上午我们有两___体育课，八点开始。
zh: 周三上午我们有两节体育课，八点开始。
py: zhōu sān shàng wǔ wǒ men yǒu liǎng jié tǐ yù kè bā diǎn kāi shǐ
en: On Wednesday morning we have two PE periods, starting at eight.
why: Two periods on the timetable are 两节课. 门 would mean two separate subjects.

s: 我家有五个口人。
s_py: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ gè kǒu rén
zh: 我家有五口人。
py: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén
en: There are five people in my family.
why: 口 is the measure for family members and takes no 个 before it.

q: 他毕业以后找到了一___在体育杂志社的工作。
zh: 他毕业以后找到了一份在体育杂志社的工作。
py: tā bì yè yǐ hòu zhǎo dào le yī fèn zài tǐ yù zá zhì shè de gōng zuò
en: After graduating he found a job at a sports magazine.
why: A job takes 份. 瓶 is for bottles, 套 for sets and 双 for pairs.

q: 我家楼下有一___小猫，每天晚上都叫。
zh: 我家楼下有一只小猫，每天晚上都叫。
py: wǒ jiā lóu xià yǒu yī zhī xiǎo māo měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu jiào
en: There is a little cat downstairs from my flat that meows every night.
why: A cat is a small animal: 只. 头 is for cattle and pigs, 条 for fish and 匹 for horses.

q: 地铁站对面新开了一___咖啡店。
zh: 地铁站对面新开了一家咖啡店。
py: dì tiě zhàn duì miàn xīn kāi le yī jiā kā fēi diàn
en: A new coffee shop has opened across from the subway station.
why: Shops and other businesses take 家. 座 is for big structures, 层 for floors, 位 for polite counting of people.

q: 跑完步以后，我想喝一___冰水。
zh: 跑完步以后，我想喝一瓶冰水。
py: pǎo wán bù yǐ hòu wǒ xiǎng hē yī píng bīng shuǐ
en: After running I'd like to drink a bottle of iced water.
why: A bottle of water is 一瓶水, with no 个. 双 is for pairs, 套 for sets, 份 for portions.

zh: 体育馆旁边新开了一家很大的运动用品店。
py: tǐ yù guǎn páng biān xīn kāi le yī jiā hěn dà de yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn
en: A very big sports goods shop has opened next to the gym.
why: Shops take 家, and the measure comes before the description: 一家很大的运动用品店.

q: 你想去哪___公园跑步？
zh: 你想去哪个公园跑步？
py: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ ge gōng yuán pǎo bù
en: Which park do you want to run in?
why: 哪 needs a measure: 哪个公园. 哪些 asks about several parks, but the cue asks about one.

q: 酒店还有一___双人房间，您要吗？
zh: 酒店还有一间双人房间，您要吗？
py: jiǔ diàn hái yǒu yī jiān shuāng rén fáng jiān nín yào ma
en: The hotel still has a double room. Would you like it?
why: Rooms take 间. 家 is for the hotel as a business, 座 for large buildings, 层 for floors.

q: 这家公司在市中心开了五___分店，生意都很好。
zh: 这家公司在市中心开了五家分店，生意都很好。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī zài shì zhōng xīn kāi le wǔ jiā fēn diàn shēng yì dōu hěn hǎo
en: This company has opened five branches in the city centre, and business is good at all of them.
why: Branches are businesses, so 家 again. 座, 间 and 层 count large buildings, rooms and floors.

s: 老师说了一遍，我还是没听懂。
s_py: lǎo shī shuō le yī biàn wǒ hái shì méi tīng dǒng
zh: 老师说了一遍，我还是没听懂。
py: lǎo shī shuō le yī biàn wǒ hái shì méi tīng dǒng
en: The teacher said it once through, and I still did not understand.
why: 遍 is right when the teacher goes through the whole thing once.

q: 我们队有十一___人，一起踢足球。
zh: 我们队有十一个人，一起踢足球。
py: wǒ men duì yǒu shí yí gè rén yì qǐ tī zú qiú
en: Our team has eleven people who play football together.
why: A plain count of people uses 个. 位 is polite and never goes straight before bare 人, and 口 counts family members.

q: 打篮球要穿一___合适的球鞋。
zh: 打篮球要穿一双合适的球鞋。
py: dǎ lán qiú yào chuān yī shuāng hé shì de qiú xié
en: You need to wear a suitable pair of shoes to play basketball.
why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双. 条 is for trousers, 件 for tops and 把 for things with a handle.

q: 我们去饭馆吃了一___晚饭，然后去看电影。
zh: 我们去饭馆吃了一顿晚饭，然后去看电影。
py: wǒ men qù fàn guǎn chī le yī dùn wǎn fàn rán hòu qù kàn diàn yǐng
en: We had dinner at a restaurant and then went to see a film.
why: A meal takes 顿. 场 is for matches and shows, 首 for songs and 部 for films.

q: 我们在海边度了两___星期的假，每天都去游泳。
zh: 我们在海边度了两个星期的假，每天都去游泳。
py: wǒ men zài hǎi biān dù le liǎng gè xīng qī de jiǎ měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
en: We spent a two-week holiday at the seaside and swam every day.
why: Weeks take 个: 两个星期. 次 and 条 are not measures for weeks.

q: 我打算在北京住两___月，每天去公园打太极拳。
zh: 我打算在北京住两个月，每天去公园打太极拳。
py: wǒ dǎ suàn zài běi jīng zhù liǎng gè yuè měi tiān qù gōng yuán dǎ tài jí quán
en: I plan to live in Beijing for two months and go and do tai chi in the park every day.
why: Counting months needs 个: 两个月. 两月 would read as 'February', not a length of time.

q: 那___楼有三十层，是这个城市最高的。
zh: 那座楼有三十层，是这个城市最高的。
py: nà zuò lóu yǒu sān shí céng shì zhè ge chéng shì zuì gāo de
en: That building has thirty floors and is the tallest in the city.
why: A tall building is a large fixed structure: 座. 间 is for rooms and 家 for businesses.

q: 他在运动商店买了一___新裤子。
zh: 他在运动商店买了一条新裤子。
py: tā zài yùn dòng shāng diàn mǎi le yī tiáo xīn kù zi
en: He bought a pair of new trousers at the sports shop.
why: Trousers are long and bendy: 条. 件 is for tops, and 双 is for shoes and other things that come as two separate items.

q: 他每天早上喝一___牛奶，然后去游泳。
zh: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶，然后去游泳。
py: tā měi tiān zǎo shàng hē yī bēi niú nǎi rán hòu qù yóu yǒng
en: Every morning he drinks a glass of milk and then goes swimming.
why: A drink in a cup or glass takes 杯. 双, 套 and 件 count pairs, sets and clothes.

zh: 我买了三张电影票。
py: wǒ mǎi le sān zhāng diàn yǐng piào
en: I bought three cinema tickets.
why: Tickets are flat, so the measure is 张, and it sits between the number and the noun.

q: 昨晚下了一___大雨，球场上到处都是水，今天的比赛只好推迟。
zh: 昨晚下了一场大雨，球场上到处都是水，今天的比赛只好推迟。
py: zuó wǎn xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ qiú chǎng shàng dào chù dōu shì shuǐ jīn tiān de bǐ sài zhǐ hǎo tuī chí
en: A heavy rain fell last night and the pitch is under water, so today's match has to be put off.
why: A fall of rain that runs its course is 一场雨. 顿 is for meals, 首 for songs, 节 for class periods.

q: 地铁站旁边有___银行，取钱很方便。
zh: 地铁站旁边有三家银行，取钱很方便。
py: dì tiě zhàn páng biān yǒu sān jiā yín háng qǔ qián hěn fāng biàn
en: There are three banks next to the subway station, so it is easy to withdraw money.
why: Number first, then the measure, then the noun: 三家银行. 三银行 has no measure and 家三 reverses the order.

q: 我在书店买了一___介绍游泳的书。
zh: 我在书店买了一本介绍游泳的书。
py: wǒ zài shū diàn mǎi le yī běn jiè shào yóu yǒng de shū
en: I bought a book about swimming at the bookshop.
why: Bound books take 本. 张 is for flat sheets and 条 for long things.

q: 下雨了，我没带伞，你能借我一___吗？
zh: 下雨了，我没带伞，你能借我一把吗？
py: xià yǔ le wǒ méi dài sǎn nǐ néng jiè wǒ yī bǎ ma
en: It's raining and I did not bring an umbrella. Could you lend me one?
why: An umbrella has a handle you hold, so 把. 支 is for pens, 条 for long bendy things, 件 for clothes.

q: 你买的这___自行车多少钱？
zh: 你买的这辆自行车多少钱？
py: nǐ mǎi de zhè liàng zì xíng chē duō shǎo qián
en: How much was this bike you bought?
why: Bicycles have wheels, so 辆. 这些 would mean 'these bikes', but the cue speaks of one.

q: 你的水杯里还有一点儿___水吗？
zh: 你的水杯里还有一点儿水吗？
py: nǐ de shuǐ bēi lǐ hái yǒu yī diǎn r shuǐ ma
en: Is there still a little water in your bottle?
why: 一点儿 goes straight onto the noun: 一点儿水. Adding 杯 or 个 after it is wrong.

q: 这___运动鞋适合爬山，那种适合跑步。
zh: 这种运动鞋适合爬山，那种适合跑步。
py: zhè zhǒng yùn dòng xié shì hé pá shān nà zhǒng shì hé pǎo bù
en: This kind of trainer is good for hiking, and that kind is good for running.
why: 'This kind of' is 这种. 首, 顿 and 场 count songs, meals and events, and the contrast with 那种 shows kinds.

s: 我想买一个杯子送给教练。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí gè bēi zi sòng gěi jiào liàn
zh: 我想买一个杯子送给教练。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí gè bēi zi sòng gěi jiào liàn
en: I want to buy a mug to give to the coach.
why: Here the cup itself is the thing being counted, so it is a noun that takes 个.

q: 我给在上海的朋友写了一___信，告诉他我参加了城市马拉松。
zh: 我给在上海的朋友写了一封信，告诉他我参加了城市马拉松。
py: wǒ gěi zài shàng hǎi de péng yǒu xiě le yī fēng xìn gào sù tā wǒ cān jiā le chéng shì mǎ lā sōng
en: I wrote a letter to my friend in Shanghai to tell him I had taken part in the city marathon.
why: Letters take 封. 张 is for flat sheets such as a postcard, and 本 is for bound volumes.

q: 他买了一___运动服，上衣和裤子都是蓝色的。
zh: 他买了一套运动服，上衣和裤子都是蓝色的。
py: tā mǎi le yī tào yùn dòng fú shàng yī hé kù zi dōu shì lán sè de
en: He bought a tracksuit, with both the top and the trousers in blue.
why: A top and trousers sold together form a set, so 套. 件 and 条 would count only the top or only the trousers.

q: 电影院在商场的五___，坐电梯上去就是。
zh: 电影院在商场的五层，坐电梯上去就是。
py: diàn yǐng yuàn zài shāng chǎng de wǔ céng zuò diàn tī shàng qù jiù shì
en: The cinema is on the fifth floor of the mall; just take the lift up.
why: A floor of a building is 层. 家 and 间 count businesses and rooms, and 座 counts whole buildings.
